what_it_does: Broad health insurance for individuals and families with extensive coverage and no room-rent cap in many variants.
coverage_highlights: No room rent cap (you can choose any room category as per policy terms)
In-patient hospitalization expenses
Pre-hospitalization expenses (typically up to 60 days)
Post-hospitalization expenses (typically up to 90 days)
Maternity and newborn baby coverage after applicable waiting period
Coverage for many modern treatments and procedures
Bariatric (weight-loss) surgery as per policy conditions
Second medical opinion facility
100% restoration of the sum insured once in a policy year after exhaustion
key_conditions: Waiting periods apply for pre-existing diseases (multi-year in many cases)
Waiting period for maternity and newborn benefits
Specific waiting periods for listed illnesses and procedures
Sub-limits and co-pays may apply depending on the chosen variant and age
General exclusions like cosmetic surgery, non-medical expenses, etc.

insurer_metrics_notes.network_hospitals: 14,000+ network hospitals offering cashless treatment (approximate reported figure).
insurer_metrics_notes.claim_settlement_ratio_trend: Health claim settlement ratio roughly in the 80–90% band in recent years (indicative range).
insurer_metrics_notes.regulatory_notes: Standalone health insurer with strong cashless approvals; some periods of regulatory scrutiny on claim practices have been reported.

best_for: Individuals and families who want flexibility in choosing hospital room (no room-rent cap in many variants)
Customers who prioritize a strong cashless network and are comfortable reading detailed terms and exclusions

what_it_does: Provides a single shared sum insured for the entire family under one health policy.
coverage_highlights: In-patient hospitalization for all covered family members
Daycare procedures that do not require 24-hour hospitalization
Organ donor expenses as per policy terms
Automatic restoration of sum insured after it is exhausted (subject to conditions)
Worldwide emergency coverage in many variants (emergency treatments outside India)
Maternity and newborn coverage options after applicable waiting periods
Cashless hospitalization at Star Health’s extensive network hospitals
key_conditions: Waiting periods for pre-existing diseases, maternity and specified illnesses apply
Certain sub-limits, co-pays or disease-wise limits may exist depending on variant and age
Maximum age and relationship rules for who can be included in the floater
best_for: 3–5 member families who prefer a single floater policy instead of multiple individual covers
Families looking for restoration benefits and optional worldwide emergency coverage

what_it_does: Comprehensive health insurance for individuals and families with strong restoration and wellness/check-up features.
coverage_highlights: In-patient care for hospitalization above 24 hours
Daycare treatments that require less than 24 hours of hospitalization
Coverage for AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) and modern treatments
Organ donor expenses as per policy terms
Pre-hospitalization expenses for a defined number of days
Post-hospitalization expenses for a defined number of days
Unlimited sum insured restoration in many variants when sum insured is exhausted
Annual health check-ups for insured members (subject to terms)
Cashless hospitalization at Niva Bupa’s network hospitals
optional_riders: Claim protection / claim safeguard rider (covers non-payable items or protects NCB, depending on design)
family_coverage: Can cover up to 19 family members in certain family floater structures, making it suitable for large/joint families.

insurer_metrics_notes.claim_settlement_ratio_trend: CSR and ICR generally in a competitive band for standalone health insurers (exact numbers vary by year and product).
insurer_metrics_notes.positioning: Strong focus on urban, digitally savvy customers with emphasis on cashless, wellness and check-up benefits.

best_for: Tech-savvy individuals and families who value unlimited restoration and wellness features like annual check-ups
Large or joint families needing coverage for many members under one umbrella

positioning: Large standalone health insurer offering multiple products across health, personal accident and travel segments.
key_features: Network of 14,000+ hospitals providing cashless treatment, especially strong in many urban and semi-urban areas
24/7 customer support and digital claim intimation/monitoring
Coverage for pre-existing diseases after completion of specified waiting periods
Maternity and newborn coverage in eligible plans after waiting periods
Multiple riders/add-ons such as personal accident, critical illness, top-up and super top-up options

key_metrics.claim_settlement_ratio_trend: CSR approximately in the 80–88% range in recent years (varies by year and source).
key_metrics.incurred_claim_ratio_trend: ICR generally within the typical health insurance band, reflecting high claim volumes.
key_metrics.notes: One of the largest retail health insurers in India by number of policies and claims handled.
